from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
import numpy as np

X = np.random.randn(100, 5)
clf = IsolationForest(n_estimators=10, warm_start=True, behaviour='new', random_state=0)
clf.fit(X)
assert len(clf.estimators_) == 10
clf.n_estimators += 10
clf.fit(X)
assert len(clf.estimators_) == 20
print("OK")
EOF
